watch.summary: After getting blown out 1-12 in Rocket League, a streamer desperately begs to score just one goal, only for his opponent to immediately score off kickoff.

beats.what: Streamer laughs hysterically in embarrassment after getting scored on to fall behind 1-12.
Streamer resets and insists he just needs to score one goal himself.
The opponent scores immediately off the kickoff to make it 1-13.
Streamer rages in mock outrage, yelling that he was supposed to score, not his opponent.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Not him, me! Not him, me! I need to score one!
watch.why: The immediate contradiction of asking for one goal only to get scored on instantly creates great comedic timing. The creator's passionate, yelling reaction highlights the absurd embarrassment of the situation.
